text:
maya: Heads-up — Lumina renewal is moving to a 9mo term and they want to add 10 Accelerator seats. They asked for net30 but procurement insists on a PO. Pricing approved a prorated credit for the unused months, but we need to lock signature flow. can we get legal + procurement eyes? cc @kevin-renewals @eli-legal @james-procure :eyes:

kevin-renewals: ok — sounds fine. we can do Docusign once PO is in. who are the signers on their side? CFO or delegated approver? :thinking_face:

maya: signers are Linda M. (CFO) and Sam P. (Procurement). timeline: customer wants to close by end of week but PO might take 7–10 business days. if PO delays, they'd prefer card payment as fallback.

maya: pricing calc below for transparency:
```
Base annual -> prorated for 9mo: $12,000 -> $9,000
Accelerator 10 seats: $3,000/mo -> 9mo = $27,000 -> prorated add-on credit for overlap = -$1,800
One-time onboarding credit: -$1,200
Total due at amendment: $33,000 - $3,000 credit = $30,000 (invoice net30)
```

sara-ops: quick ops notes — if they pay by CC we can provision immediately. if PO + wire, ops needs vendor code + invoice entity to create invoice in Stripe/Billing. also confirm KMS requirement (they said yes earlier).

james-procure: procurement can issue PO but we need vendor code and legal entity. vendor code for Lumina is VC-4491? (please confirm). if they want net30 we need signed SOW/amendment + PO on file. we can expedite to 48–72h once vendor code and approver are confirmed.

eli-legal: flagged — 9mo term is a material change vs the original MSA. please attach the amendment (one-pager) that calls out prorate math, Accelerator addendum, and explicit payment fallback (card if PO delayed). wet-sign should be last resort — Docusign preferred. if Docusign fails, we can accept wet-sign but will need countersigned scanned copy + ops confirmation before provisioning. timeline: legal review ~24h if we use our standard renewal amendment template.

kevin-renewals: i'll draft the amendment and include a PO field and a "payment fallback: CC" checkbox. i'll prepare the Docusign envelope and hold sending until we get confirmation of vendor code/PO. will include a note: "If PO not available within 7 business days, card payment accepted to avoid provisioning delay."

docusign-bot: Envelope created (env_0xABC123). Recipients: Linda M. (CFO) — sent; Sam P. (Procurement) — sent. Status: sent to first signer. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0xABC123 :email:

maya: perfect. i'll update Lumina CSM notes and set a follow-up in 48h. if procurement confirms vendor code, please @kevin-renewals to send envelope. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sara-ops: checklist added to thread: 1) confirm vendor code & entity 2) legal signoff on amendment 3) procurement PO or CC fallback 4) send Docusign envelope 5) ops to create invoice & provision once signed. i'll watch for payment method change and ping finance if CC used.

maya: tagging outcome here once signed or if we need wet-sign fallback.
